'''Peter Bürgisser''' (born 1962) is a Swiss mathematician and theoretical computer scientist who deals with algorithmic algebra and algebraic complexity theory.

==Education and career==
Bürgisser received in 1990 his doctorate from the [[University of Konstanz]] with thesis ''Degenerationsordnung und Trägerfunktional bilinearer Abbildungen''<ref>{{cite web|title=Degenerationsordnung und Trägerfunktional bilinearer Abbildungen|website=Institut für Mathematik, TU Berlin|url=https://www.math.tu-berlin.de/fachgebiete_ag_diskalg/fachgebiet_algorithmische_algebra/v_menue/publications/theses/?tx_sibibtex_pi1%5Bcontentelement%5D=tt_content%3A541957&tx_sibibtex_pi1%5BshowUid%5D=1351105&cHash=d0ec9a6e528673da81783ceb986f7cc0'}}</ref> under the supervision of [[Volker Strassen]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=26432}}</ref> Bürgisser was a postdoc at the [[University of Bonn]] from 1991 to 1993 and then at the [[University of Zürich]].<ref name="BürgisserClausen1996">{{cite book|author1=Peter Bürgisser|author2=Michael Clausen|author3=Amin Shokrollahi|title=Algebraic Complexity Theory|chapter=Acknowledgements|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=dYcgjfXsYk8C&pg=PR17|page=xvii|date=16 December 1996|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=978-3-540-60582-9}}</ref> He was a professor at the [[University of Paderborn]] and since 2013 a professor at [[Technische Universität Berlin]] (TU Berlin).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.math.tu-berlin.de/fachgebiete_ag_diskalg/fachgebiet_algorithmische_algebra/v_menue/members/prof_dr_peter_buergisser/|title=Prof. Dr. Peter Bürgisser|website=Institut für Mathematik, TU Berlin}}</ref>

His research deals with efficient algorithms for the solution of algebraic problems and lower bounds in the [[Computational complexity theory|complexity of algebraic problems]], as well as with symbolic and numerical algorithms and the probabilistic analysis of numerical algorithms.

With [[Felipe Cucker]] in 2011 he contributed to the solution of [[Smale's problems|Smale's Problem]] No. 17.

Bürgisser was a visiting scholar at the [[Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing]] in Berkeley.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://simons.berkeley.edu/people/peter-burgisser|title=Peter Bürgisser, Professor, Technische Universität Berlin|website=Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing|date=25 June 2013 }}</ref> He was also a visiting scholar at [[ETH Zurich]].

In 2010, he was an invited speaker with talk ''Smoothed Analysis of Condition Numbers''<ref>{{cite book|last1=Bürgisser|first1=Peter|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians 2010 |chapter=Smoothed Analysis of Condition Numbers|year=2011|pages=2609–2633|doi=10.1142/9789814324359_0160|isbn=978-981-4324-30-4}}</ref> at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Hyderabad]]. He was a plenary speaker at the 2008 conference of the organization [[Foundations of Computational Mathematics]] (FoCM) in Hong Kong<ref>{{cite book|editor1=Cucker, Felipe|editor2=Pinkus, Allan|author3=Todd, Michael|chapter=''Smoothed Analysis of Condition Numbers'' by Peter Bürgisser|title=Foundations of Computational Mathematics, Hong Kong 2008|pages=1–41|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=UYf_lHhL3sYC&pg=PA1|date=2 July 2009|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=978-0-521-73970-2}}</ref> and organized workshops on complexity theory at the 2005, 2008 and 2011 workshops and in the 2009 and 2012 [[Oberwolfach Research Institute for Mathematics|Oberwolfach]] workshops. He was elected a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2012.

He is a member of the editorial staff of ''[[Foundations of Computational Mathematics]]''.

In 2018 he was awarded an [[European Research Council|ERC]] Advanced Grant.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://erc.easme-web.eu/?p=787840|title=Complexity and Condition in Algebra and Numerics (COCAN) |publisher=European Research Council|accessdate=2021-10-20}}</ref>

== Further Activities ==
In Bürgisser`s youth, he acted in [https://www.imdb.com/name/nm1154803/?ref_=nv_sr_srsg_0 four short-films] by his school-mate [[Roger Steinmann]] as lead-actor.  'Die Flutkatastrophe' and 'Die Türe' were aired in the Swiss national TV DRS, the latter accompanied with an interview by Bürgisser.<ref>{{cite web|title=R O G E R S T E I N M A N N|periodical=|publisher=|url=http://roger-steinmann.com/filmography.html|url-status=|access-date=|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref>
